title: Router power
review_mode: read-only review of retained scientific/equation/evidence records; no fitting, acquisition or new literature search

portfolio_disposition: Scoped numerical references, tested hypotheses and preserved falsifications; no independently established new fundamental law or demonstrated deployment impact is admitted.

finding_reviews.statement: Packet-composition information helps throughput-only prediction, but the compact workload equation loses to the flexible comparator.
finding_reviews.historical_evidence_status: Original historical reserve status is retained in source records; every outcome is exposed now. Continuation model selection uses development evidence but cannot restore fresh confirmation.

equation_if_supported.interpretation: Executable numerical representation only; mechanism/novelty admission is assessed separately. Displayed coefficients can be rounded; exact executable states are authoritative.

finding_reviews.strongest_adverse_evidence: Compact wins only 1/5 runs against flexible; routerA standalone byte-load coefficient is negative. Packet rate is algebraic throughput/size rather than independent energy evidence.

reliability.rationale: The retained evidence supports the stated narrow conclusion under Complete router/protocol/repetition runs; two calibrated routers; no future traffic or measured power history. mechanism.rationale: Workload correlates with power; separate byte, packet and thermal costs are not experimentally identified.

novelty.rationale: Saturation/workload power models are established; no independent new processing law is supported. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.

significance.rationale: The measured endpoint and matched controls supply a useful reproducible local benchmark. Complete router/protocol/repetition runs; two calibrated routers; no future traffic or measured power history.

reproducibility.rationale: Frozen equations/model states and numerical evidence are present and hash-bound here. This scientific document review is separate from independent computational replay; execution validity must be supplied by that review and the raw-preparation audit.

impact.rationale: Potential monitoring, calibration or experiment-planning value is bounded by the stated endpoint. No operational intervention, measured deployment savings, clinical effect or independent real-world benefit is demonstrated in this portfolio.

scientific_validators: Compare whole-run errors by router/protocol and retain the missing power response.
Keep algebraic packet-rate derivation explicit and test matched information access.
Require a future-input perturbation test for any dynamic submission and independently timed temperature for thermal claims.
